column2: Berkuts keep appearing at Loralai in Nakfa, in the untamed lands, and livestock and people are being hurt.{wait}{clear}The Berkuts swoop silently from the sky, and the villagers are helpless against them.{wait}{clear}Won't you please go to Loralai and drive the Berkuts off?

Hobgoblins have appeared on the outskirts of the village of Mirzapur in Bobar, attacking anyone who leaves or heads for the village.{wait}{clear}Because of that, the village is cut off. Won't you please defeat the hobgoblins and save the village?

A sea dragon has appeared off the coast of the village of Salem in Karnal.{wait}{clear}The village lives by fishing, and because of the sea dragon its boats can't put out. They're in serious trouble.{wait}{clear}Won't you please defeat the sea dragon and help the village?

In Ripa, in Nashik, eerie voices are heard from the sea at night.{wait}{clear}They say Nashik is a place many people visit for its beautiful sea.{wait}{clear}But since the eerie voices began, no one comes anymore.{wait}{clear}Won't you please find out what's behind those voices?

People are vanishing from the village of Nuuk in Lemborg.{wait}{clear}Neighbors vanish without anyone noticing, a wife or husband sleeping right beside someone is suddenly gone. Strange things keep happening.{wait}{clear}No one has heard a scream or a sound, and the village is helpless against these eerie events.{wait}{clear}Would you go to Nuuk and find out what's causing them?

An unknown monster has appeared on the highway near Quetta in Frezelecia.{wait}{clear}It's a huge creature with two beastlike faces, and it attacks people on the highway.{wait}{clear}I'd like you to go and defeat this monster...

An unknown monster has appeared on the highway near Recife in Lorca.{wait}{clear}With the snakes coiled around its body and its huge hands, it attacks people on the highway. Won't you please go and defeat it?

An unknown monster has appeared on the highway near Seriphos in Delfzijl.{wait}{clear}It's a creepy creature with a flabby body, and it attacks people on the highway. Won't you please go and defeat it?

Many people have gone missing in the town of Tran in Kran.{wait}{clear}What the missing people have in common is that they all went to a certain mansion, and that mansion belongs to a crooked moneylender.{wait}{clear}I'm worried about the missing people. Would you go and find out what's going on in that mansion?

A Scylla has made its nest on the highway in Ellora and is blocking travel.{wait}{clear}That highway links the west and east of Legrance and is very important, so a party was formed to hunt it, but it ended in disaster.{wait}{clear}For the people's sake, would you go and destroy the Scylla?

I sense something ominous stirring in Cadiz, in the Kingdom of Legrance.{wait}{clear}Soldiers have begun gathering in the wilds around a two-headed monster.{wait}{clear}If monsters join the rebels and they start attacking towns and villages, the harm will be enormous.{wait}{clear}Before something terrible happens, would you go to Cadiz?

I've found a monster stronghold in the town of Siragusa in Almavila.{wait}{clear}There are many monsters there, and they're about to start invading the towns and villages around it.{wait}{clear}Before it's too late, would you go there and defeat them?

A vampire has appeared in the village of Sigul in Anadyr and is attacking the villagers.{wait}{clear}No one will help a little village shut in by the snowfields, and at this rate it will be wiped out. Please, save the people!
A Tindalos has appeared in Liege in Delfzijl, and the village is in danger of being wiped out!{wait}{clear}You're the only one who can defeat this monster, the hero. I beg you, go to Liege.

Demons have appeared on the highway in Lucena.{wait}{clear}At this rate they may reach Fanlan, the capital.{wait}{clear}If that happens, terror will spread through the whole Kingdom of Legrance.{wait}{clear}That would be terrible. I beg you, go and defeat the demons.

Two Tindalos have appeared in the town of Ilyus in Valese, and the whole town is in chaos.{wait}{clear}It may only be a matter of time before every last person there is torn apart.{wait}{clear}To somehow help the people, would you go to Ilyus?

I've had word that a mysterious ritual is being performed in Utrera, in Taishut.{wait}{clear}They say Black Mages gather night after night to summon monsters.{wait}{clear}It would be terrible if it led to great chaos. Won't you go to Utrera and put a stop to the ritual?
In Roeselare, in Riaza, only women are going missing.{wait}{clear}There are no clues at all, so I'm very worried about whether they're safe.{wait}{clear}Would you go and find out what is going on?
Demons have appeared in Limeira in Riga, and the city has fallen into chaos.{wait}{clear}You're the only one who can defeat demons, the hero. I beg you, would you go to Limeira?
Gremlins are attacking the village of Curo in Riaza.{wait}{clear}A pack of small, quick gremlins is too much for the villagers to handle. I beg you, would you go to Curo?

A strange demon has appeared in Turkana in Elmed, in the untamed lands.{wait}{clear}A demon appearing in the sacred Reyforia Forest is something no one could have imagined.{wait}{clear}It must be a demon of immense power. The only one who can fight such a being is you, the hero.{wait}{clear}Please, defeat the demon!

A black shadow keeps being sighted near Ceara in Langusa.{wait}{clear}Ever since the sightings began, cargo has gone missing from carriages on the highway, and people have suddenly disappeared.{wait}{clear}The black shadow is thought to be the cause, but no one knows what it is. So would you go and find out?
I'm sorry, but I can't bring myself to act without knowing why.{wait}{clear}Isn't there somewhere else I ought to go?
Sorry, but I don't see a reason to go there...{wait}{clear}Right now, I don't want to leave this place... Forgive me.
I'm sorry, but I don't see any reason for me to go... Could you ask someone else?
I'm sorry, but my hands are full right now. Can't someone else go?
Me, go somewhere like that?{wait}{clear}Sorry, but I can't afford to go somewhere pointless... Forgive me.
I'm sorry. There's something I absolutely have to do.{wait}{clear}I'm afraid I can't take that request... Could you ask someone else?
I've got my hands full with other things.
I'm not idle enough to go somewhere that pointless.
I won't act without a reason.
Sorry, but I have things to do. Try someone else... My apologies...
My hands are full with something else right now. Sorry, but I can't go there...
Sorry! I can't go there right now.{wait}{clear}I hate to say it, but could you ask someone else?
I don't want to go somewhere like that for no reason. Sorry, but could you ask someone else?
I'm not so idle that I'd go somewhere that makes no sense.
Sorry, but there's something else I've got to do.{wait}{clear}My bad! Next time I'll help for sure.
No thanks to a request that makes no sense. I'm not that idle.{wait}{clear}If that's all it is, why not ask somebody else?
I don't see why I'd need to go to a place like that.{wait}{clear}Why not ask somebody else?
There's no need for me to go somewhere that makes no sense, is there?{wait}{clear}Sorry, but ask someone else.
Sorry! I'm kind of tied up right now. Could you ask someone else?
Sorry! I can't go there right now.{wait}{clear}Ask someone else!
No way. Sorry, but I'm not idle enough to go somewhere that makes no sense.
You want me to go somewhere that makes no sense? Sorry, but no way.{wait}{clear}I don't want to waste my time. Ask someone else, okay?
Whaaat?! You want me to go somewhere like that?{wait}{clear}Sorry, but that kind of thing isn't for me. Ask someone else, okay?
Sorry. There's something else I really have to do. Could you ask someone else instead?
I'm sorry. There is something I absolutely must do. Could you ask someone else instead?
I'm sorry... I simply can't go there right now... Forgive me...
Sorry, but I'm not idle enough to act without a reason.{wait}{clear}For a request like that, would you ask someone else?
